errors.text_span: Акци и дялове на КИС/ Борсово търгувани продукти
errors.evidence: The description misspells one of the categories from the legend. It should be "Акции" (Shares), not "Акци".
The word "значително" (significant) is a subjective interpretation, which the prompt instructs to avoid. A more neutral description would state the change in values.

Describing the recovery in 2020 and 2021 as "леко" (slight) is an over-generalization. The value in 2021 (approx. 87,000) is nearly double the low point in 2019 (approx. 44,000), which is not a slight increase.

The prompt asks to include representative values for the shortest and highest bars. The description gives a value for the highest bar (2014) but fails to provide a value for the shortest bar (2019, approx. 44,000).
